Data.String: PIC-308: loop pressure at V-101, sets the purge FIC-303 (D-019). AI-305: H2, CO, CO2, CH4 of the loop gas (inerts, stoichiometric number). HS-304 opens XV-304: loop depressuring
LZ-306: V-101 level low-low closes XV-306 against gas blow-by into V-102 (C&E I-301). LZ-313: V-101 level high-high stops K-102 and K-101 (C&E I-302). LIC-307, LIC-310: level let-down
PSV-302: V-101 and the HP loop (fire, thermal); PSV-311: V-102 (gas blow-by from V-101, fire); PSV-312: E-103 CW side (tube rupture); all to the HP flare header (D-019, D-022)
